description.narrative: Kosovo, TB/HIV, Community Development Fund (CDF)This program has the following goals: Promote transition readiness and full transition to government financing of all services including implemented by civil society. Assure continuation of evidence-based programs for key and vulnerable populations. Respond to human rights and gender-related barriers and vulnerabilities in access to services.. The objectives of this program are: Implement capacity-building and legal framework developement activities tailored to the needs of civil society organizations to strengthen their ability to manage government funds, comply with regulatory requirements, and sustain service delivery. Establish mechanisms for collaboration and partnership between government agencies and civil society organizations to facilitate a smooth transition process, including joint planning, resource sharing, and knowledge exchange. Advocate for policy reforms and legislative changes to support the transition to government financing, including the development of funding mechanisms that prioritize sustainability, equity, and accountability. Identify and prioritize evidence-based programs that have demonstrated effectiveness in addressing the needs of key and vulnerable populations. Develop guidelines and standards for the implementation of evidence-based interventions. Allocate resources and funding to support the scale-up and expansion of evidence-based interventions with the greatest potential for impact and reach among key and vulnerable populations. Identify human rights and gender-related barriers and vulnerabilities in access to services, including discrimination, stigma, violence, and lack of legal protection. Develop and implement policies and strategies to address these barriers, including measures to promote equality, non-discrimination, and meaningful participation of KPs in decision-making processes. Provide training and capacity-building activities for service providers to enhance their understanding of human rights and gender issues and their ability to provide inclusive not-stigmatizing and non-discriminatory services
